name: travelmyth
description: Search hotels worldwide on Travelmyth by destination, dates, guests and 60 hotel categories, with prices from the booking sites it compares.

interface.longDescription:
Travelmyth is a hotel search engine that sorts hotels around the world into 60 categories, such as spa, beachfront, infinity pool, dog friendly, family friendly, adults only, castle, ski-in ski-out and overwater bungalows.

Ask for hotels in a city, a region or a country, or anywhere in the world, and say what matters to you. Travelmyth answers with matching hotels: a description, a summary of guest reviews, star and guest ratings, a photo and the categories each hotel belongs to.

Add check-in and check-out dates, and the number of guests and rooms, to see for each hotel the lowest total found among the booking sites Travelmyth compares, with taxes and charges included, and the average per night in the currency you choose.

Every hotel links to its page on Travelmyth with your dates applied, where all the offers are listed, and every answer links to the full list of results.

Good to know: Travelmyth here only searches. It does not book rooms, take payments or manage reservations, and it needs no account or sign-in. A search returns up to 10 hotels. Prices need dates: check-in up to 18 months ahead, stays of up to 30 nights, up to 3 rooms. Children are priced as 8-year-olds. Hotel texts are in English.
defaultPrompt: Find spa hotels in Paris for next weekend
Family-friendly hotels in Crete for a week in July, 2 adults and 2 kids, prices in euros
Show me hotels with overwater bungalows anywhere in the world

positive.description: Hotels in a category, with dates and prices
positive.prompt: Find spa hotels in Paris from 12 to 14 May 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with destination Paris, categories [spa], checkin 2027-05-12 and checkout 2027-05-14. The reply lists spa hotels in Paris; how many depends on what is available for those dates at the time of the search, up to 10. Each one has its guest rating, the price per night and the total for the 2 nights, and a link to its Travelmyth page that opens with those dates; some hotels are described in more detail. The reply states what was assumed for the details the prompt left out, such as 2 adults and the currency.

Calls search_hotels with destination Nice and categories [beachfront], without dates. The reply lists beachfront hotels in Nice with ratings, a short description and links, shows no prices, says that prices need check-in and check-out dates, and offers to search again with dates.

positive.description: Family trip with guests, a week of dates and a currency
positive.prompt: Family-friendly hotels in Crete from 5 to 12 July 2027 for 2 adults and 2 children, prices in euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with destination Crete, categories [family], checkin 2027-07-05, checkout 2027-07-12, adults 2, children 2 and currency EUR. The reply lists family hotels across Crete with nightly prices in euros and the total for the 7 nights, and states that the children were priced as 8-year-olds because no ages were given.

positive.description: Search the whole world for a rare kind of hotel
positive.prompt: Show me hotels with overwater bungalows anywhere in the world.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with destination worldwide and categories [overwater_bungalows]; it may also search single regions. The reply lists hotels with overwater bungalows in several countries, without prices because no dates were given, and links to the full list on Travelmyth.

positive.description: A place name shared by several cities, for one night
positive.prompt: A hotel in Portland, Maine for the night of 5 June 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with destination "Portland, Maine" and checkin 2027-06-05. The search runs for Portland in Maine, not Portland in Oregon, for one night. The reply lists hotels with the price for that night and states what was assumed: a one-night stay, 2 adults and the currency.

negative.description: Booking and payment are not supported: the plugin only searches, so it must not reserve a room or take a payment.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel room in Nice for tonight and charge my saved card.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is booked and nothing is charged. The reply explains that Travelmyth here can search hotels and show prices but cannot make reservations or take payments. It may search hotels in Nice for tonight and link to the hotel pages, where the user chooses an offer.

negative.description: Travel requests other than hotels, such as flights, are out of scope.
negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from Athens to London next Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: search_hotels is not called. The reply says that Travelmyth here searches hotels only and does not cover flights. ChatGPT may still answer the flight question from other sources.

negative.description: The plugin has no access to reservations or accounts, so it cannot view, change or cancel a booking.
negative.prompt: Cancel my hotel reservation for next week and refund me.
negative.expected_behavior: search_hotels is not called. The reply explains that Travelmyth here cannot see or change reservations and suggests contacting the site where the booking was made.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. It shows hotel information and, for searches with dates, prices, and it links to hotel pages on travelmyth.com. Any booking happens outside ChatGPT, on Travelmyth or on the booking site the user chooses there.

publication.release_notes: First release. One read-only tool, search_hotels: hotel search by destination, optional dates, guests, currency and up to 5 of 60 categories, with prices for searches that have dates.
